import pandas as pd

# Read the Excel file
df = pd.read_excel('/Users/bakulbadwal/Documents/GitHub/gaia-agent/runs/practice_files/p01-xlsx-late-loans/library_loans.xlsx')

# Filter for Student tier
student_loans = df[df['Tier'] == 'Student'].copy()
print(f"Student loans: {len(student_loans)}")

# Filter for checked out in March 2026
student_loans['Checked Out'] = pd.to_datetime(student_loans['Checked Out'])
march_2026_loans = student_loans[
    (student_loans['Checked Out'] >= '2026-03-01') & 
    (student_loans['Checked Out'] <= '2026-03-31')
].copy()
print(f"Student loans checked out in March 2026: {len(march_2026_loans)}")

# Show these loans
print(march_2026_loans[['Loan ID', 'Member', 'Checked Out', 'Returned']])

# Calculate days between checkout and return
march_2026_loans['Returned'] = pd.to_datetime(march_2026_loans['Returned'])
march_2026_loans['Days Diff'] = (march_2026_loans['Returned'] - march_2026_loans['Checked Out']).dt.days

# Filter out loans with no return date (NaT)
march_2026_loans_with_return = march_2026_loans.dropna(subset=['Returned'])
print(f"\nLoans with return date: {len(march_2026_loans_with_return)}")

# Count loans returned more than 21 days after checkout
late_loans = march_2026_loans_with_return[march_2026_loans_with_return['Days Diff'] > 21]
print(f"\nLoans returned more than 21 days after checkout: {len(late_loans)}")
print(late_loans[['Loan ID', 'Member', 'Checked Out', 'Returned', 'Days Diff']])
